name: Business Investment Program
provider: Government of Newfoundland and Labrador, Department of Jobs, Growth and Rural Development

summary.quote: The Business Investment Program provides term loans to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in strategic growth sectors as identified by Jobs, Growth and Rural Development.

sources.title: Business Investment Program - Jobs, Growth and Rural Development
sources.terms_note: The province owns the copyright and grants the public permission to use the information on its website; third-party graphics, audio and video may not be reproduced.

funding_types.quote: The Business Investment Program is in the form of repayable term loans at an interest rate equal to the Bank of Canada rate + 0.5%.

criteria.text: The business is based and operating in Newfoundland and Labrador
criteria.quote: Be a small and medium-sized enterprise (SME) based and operating in Newfoundland and Labrador
Be a small and medium-sized enterprise (SME) based and operating in Newfoundland and Labrador having fewer than 100 employees and less than $10 million in sales.
Be a small and medium-sized enterprise (SME) based and operating in Newfoundland and Labrador having fewer than 100 employees and less than $10 million in sales.

criteria.text: Operates in a strategic sector as defined by the Department of Jobs, Growth and Rural Development
criteria.quote: Operate in a strategic sector as defined by JGRD.

criteria.text: Needs this loan on top of funding from conventional sources
criteria.quote: Funds are provided to complement funding from conventional sources, where a need has been demonstrated

criteria.text: Able to do the work in the project proposal
criteria.quote: Demonstrate its ability to undertake the work identified in the project proposal.

criteria.text: Able to get the money needed to complete the project
criteria.quote: Demonstrate its ability to access the financial capital required to complete the project.

criteria.text: In good standing with the Government of Newfoundland and Labrador
criteria.quote: Be in good standing with the Government of Newfoundland and Labrador.

research.notes: Intake: not stated on the page, so unknown. The loan is 'repayable term loans at an interest rate equal to the Bank of Canada rate + 0.5%'; no maximum or cost share is stated. The eligibility list says applicants 'must normally' meet it; the page's 'fewer than 100 employees and less than $10 million in sales' gives employees lt 100 and revenue lt 10000000 ('sales' read as yearly revenue; reviewers, check that reading). 'Strategic sector as defined by JGRD' is not a list on the page, so it's a check-this-yourself item, not an industry rule. The summary also says 'The fund is also available to businesses which have export potential'; I did not turn that into a rule or an exception to the strategic-sector item. The page says 'Please consult with the JGRD office near you' but lists no regional numbers; the Business Growth Program page does, and could be added as a second source for contacts after review. The application form is a PDF and was not read.
